caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, double-handled cup rendered in shades of graphite gray on an off-white background. The cup features two large, symmetrically curved handles, each decorated with bead-like embellishments and floral motifs at the top and base. The body of the cup has a slightly scalloped, undulating rim and a bulging profile, segmented into panels by gently vertical curves. Three prominent decorative elements adorn the cup's surface: stylized floral motifs at the center and on each side, with intricate leaves and petals depicted in relief. Fine, dotted patterns and scroll-like details surround these floral decorations. The cup rests on a small, oval base encircled by a band with a repeating geometric border. In the lower left corner of the drawing, a small rectangular inset contains a simplified line sketch of the cup, capturing its shape and principal decorative elements in minimal detail. The edges of the paper show some discoloration, particularly in the corners, where there are orange-brown stains. The artist's signature, "Charles Cullen," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
